say:2:1331108001:1.text: I need Master Sidon's help with making a snowmaker and a portable hot spring...
say:2:1331108001:1.source_cn: 我这次来，是希望大师能够帮我制作造雪机和移动温泉……

say:3:1331108002:1.text: What are you still doing here? Didn't my master already turn you down?
